release_notes:
Redesign public site header and normalize public-page typography

The public header menu is now one coherent, customer-focused layout: sentence-case nav links with hover/active pills, a Login + Create Account CTA cluster (My Account + Logout when signed in), white card dropdowns, and a tap-friendly mobile accordion (whole-row toggles with a single rotating chevron indicator) replacing the flaky few-pixel caret targets. Public pages also move from an 11px base to the same 14px scale as the client and admin panels, so login, register and track-order no longer read smaller after logging out.
